dsh-skin-digital-arcade is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Digital arcade HUD skin: neon cyan/violet/magenta palette, Fusion Pixel fonts, animated sprites (city backdrop, data core, mascot), custom crosshair cursor; light and dark themes follow the system.
